newsitem.title: USA: Southern Peru sells power plant.
newsitem.headline: Southern Peru sells power plant.

text.p: Southern Peru Copper Corp said Friday it closed the sale of its electric power generating facilities to Energia del Sur SA (formerly Powerfin Peru), an independent power producer, for $44 million.
Energia del Sur is a subsidiary of Tractebel SA.

Terms of the sale also include an agreement for Energia del Sur to provide power to Southern Peru for 20 years and to make the necessary investment to expand power generating capacity to meet the needs of the copper company's recently announced expansion and modernization program.
Southern Peru said it currently generates 130 megawatts of power. It is 54.1 percent owned by ASARCO Inc, 14.2 percent by Marmon Corp and 13.9 pct by Phelps Dodge Corp.
